messages:
maya: Beginning controlled rollout for feature flag `route_v3`. Ramp plan: 30% -> 60% -> 100% (8m / 12m / final). Pin runtime image v3.2.1. Deploy-bot start at window.
ben: ack. Monitoring p95 + 5xx. Primary rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% for 3m OR p95 increase > 150ms vs baseline for 5m -> set flag 0%.
priya: I'll enable `debug-microcanary` (0.1%) with forced tracing. Will post saved query link when available.
sre-oncall: creating alert `route_v3_error_rate_high`: fire when 5xx > 0.4% for 4m AND deploy duration >= 6m.
deploy-bot: job db-6969696969 queued by maya. Targets: api-gateway, inference-router, routing-proxy. Starting -> 30% at 6969696975.
ben: baseline p95 210ms, 5xx 0.07%. watching.
priya: kibana saved query ready: https://kbn.redwood/s/route_v3_debug?saved=mc-6969.
maya: venting rule: on cohort error spike reduce that cohort slice by ~50% (not full disable) to avoid cascade. If errors persist after vent, full snapback.
ben: suggestion: add a microcanary label to sampled traces for easier filtering.
priya: done. `debug-microcanary` labelled and sampling increased.
ben: +6m p95 +25ms, 5xx 0.11% 94 still OK.
priya: noticed auth timeout spike from cohort id 31. Recommend venting to 10% and extra logging.
maya: vent cohort 31 -> 10% now. Keep session-sticky toggles unchanged.
deploy-bot: cohort 31 vented to 10%.
sre-oncall: brief alert triggered and cleared after cohort vent.
ben: moving to 60% after stabilization window.
deploy-bot: advanced -> 60% at 6969696979. Rolling eu-west stage.
priya: eu-west p95 jumped +160ms sustained 4m, 5xx 0.43% 94 borderline.
maya: HOLD the ramp. If 5xx exceeds 0.5% for 1m, run emergency snapback and drain job. Emergency commands in runbook.
priya: traces indicate router desync on subset of instances with older kernel. Opening infra ticket to cordon bad hosts.
sre-oncall: cordon requested; if not cordoned in 3m we will roll back and file postmortem.
ben: preparing rollback note for release notes (include exact cohorts, job id, timing, commands executed).
priya: infra cordon done, traffic shifted. eu-west p95 trending down.
ben: eu-west p95 now back to 230ms, 5xx 0.13%. Looks stable.
maya: proceed to final 100%. deploy-bot, finish rollout and mark db-6969696969 complete.
deploy-bot: job db-6969696969 advanced -> 100% at 6969696984. Rollout complete.
maya: post-deploy actions: 1) remove microcanary, 2) disable forced trace sampling, 3) restore alert thresholds, 4) update release notes with vented cohorts + infra remediation. Ben & Priya to follow up.
ben: will update release notes including rollback appendix.
priya: will remove sampling and close saved query.
maya: thanks all. Filing a short blameless note re: kernel drift; cohort venting prevented a full rollback. :tada:
